protocol.hypothesis: The four x86 losses occur only for original image launches despite unchanged x86 runtime objects, caller shape, common text locations and fixed-image observations. Separate ASLR, pathname length, file size and file identity before attributing a cause.
protocol.interpretation: Equal names are hard links to the original distinct files. Padding preserves each inode. Shared-image controls reuse one pathname and inode, replacing bytes. The latter changes file identity and replacement together. No hardware-cache cause is inferred from these controls alone.
protocol.selection: Exactly four predeclared allocations, retaining every observation and CPU identity. Original-model matches are distinguished from supplemental models. No outcome-driven allocation retries or outlier removal.
protocol.correctness: Runtime patch, frozen consumer sources, compiler options, corpus and function boundaries match R1405. Only timed launch factors and selected diagnostic cases change.

policy: All predeclared observations and all data relocations are retained. Layout movement is not itself a timing verdict. No outlier removal; 2000 deterministic resamples of 36 balanced cycles. Simulated instruction counts are not native cycles.
